facts.text: Hay deliveries for order GC-2210 go out on Tuesday morning.
Order PO-77 is for 40 bales of meadow hay.
Straw bales are in stock this week at 3.20 TU a bale.

The co-op store opens at 8:00 on Saturday and closes at 13:00.
Thanks, the co-op will order straw from Hayloft next week.
The vaccine clinic runs on Friday from 10:00.
Thanks, we will collect the rolled barley on Thursday.
Rolled barley is 9.80 TU a sack, ready to collect.
